Module com.example.cab302_project
Package com.app.studysnap.model

Interface IBadgeProgressDAO

All Known Implementing Classes:
SqliteBadgeProgressDAO
public interface IBadgeProgressDAO
Data access for tracking a user's progress toward badges.

Implementations maintain progress counters, earned flags, and goals for each badge.

  • Method Details

    • addProgress

      void addProgress(int userId, int badgeId, int value)
      Increments a user's progress toward a badge by a value (can be negative) and updates the is_earned flag based on progress_goal.
      Parameters:
      userId - user identifier
      badgeId - badge identifier
      value - delta to add to current progress (negative values decrease progress but not below 0)
      Throws:
      com.app.studysnap.exceptions.DataAccessException - on persistence failure

    • setProgress

      void setProgress(int userId, int badgeId, int value)
      Sets a user's progress toward a badge to an explicit value and updates the is_earned flag.
      Parameters:
      userId - user identifier
      badgeId - badge identifier
      value - new absolute progress value (clamped to >= 0)
      Throws:
      com.app.studysnap.exceptions.DataAccessException - on persistence failure

    • resetProgress

      void resetProgress(int userId, int badgeId)

      badgeId - badge identifier
      Throws:
